thread:
Elena H: Quick sync — we need to decide owners & acceptance for the three post-launch issues. I'm proposing owner rotations for hotpaths until next release.
Max G: Listing the three issues: 1) streaming latency spike (~p95 regressions), 2) onboarding autocomplete hallucination, 3) embeddings export timeouts during bulk import.
Ravi K: Agree — latency first. That's an SLA hit. Suggest a short-term mitigation: reduce batch window for the affected model and force single-request path for the heaviest routes.
Tara L: I can implement a config patch for batching and add a smaller batch size override for the model. ETA EOD tomorrow for PR.
Elena H: Plan: Ravi validates perf, Max coordinates canary + rollback, Tara makes patch. I'll own customer comms.
Max G: I'll open a canary route at 5% for the patch. Canary success criteria: error rate <= 0.5% and p95 <= 500ms over 30m. Rollback if either threshold breaches.
Ravi K: I'll prepare a perf job that hits the hotpath with realistic sequence lengths and KV cache warmups. Need access to the perf dashboard and the synthetic runner.
Tara L: Will open PR and include the workaround and a short rationale. PR title: "hotfix: batching override for streaming latency".
ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for pr/457 — staging build sha=abc123.
Elena H: Acceptance criteria (latency): p95 under 350ms on canary for 30m, token throughput within 10% of baseline, no elevated error rate. Also no regressions on other models per smoke tests.
Max G: Adding a quick smoke test: send 10 representative prompts and assert outputs are not truncated/corrupted. If smoke fails, block rollout.
Ravi K: On hallucination: early trace points to a prompt template change in onboarding v2. We can temporarily rollback to v1 prompt while we run a deeper eval.
Tara L: I can do a quick rollback toggle in the onboarding feature-flag and push a small PR. Customer impact should be minimal. Who does comms for this?
Elena H: I'll draft the customer note and post to #customer-success. Include mitigation, ETA for full fix (target: next tuesday), and how to opt-out.
Max G: Timeline: latency patch -> canary tomorrow midday -> full rollout if green by EOD. Hallucination rollback as separate patch mid-week. Embeddings export timeouts will be investigated in parallel but lower priority.
Ravi K: Scheduled perf run at 11:30 PST tomorrow; I'll post the results and the perf dashboard link here.
Tara L: tagging @oncall to be aware during canary and ready to escalate.
oncall: acknowledged — will monitor the canary channel and alert if SLOs degrade.
Elena H: I'll update the iteration board with owners and acceptance criteria. We'll re-run backlog grooming on Friday to recalibrate enhancement prioritization against these fixes.
Max G: Also, add a short rollback plan to the PR template (who triggers, metrics, contact list). Ravi can add the line.
Ravi K: I'll add the rollback snippet to the template now.
Elena H: Summary owners: Ravi = perf/validation, Tara = implementation, Max = rollout + rollback, Elena = comms + acceptance. Ping this thread for blockers. Closing for now.
